solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: A quiet middle of the week gives time for reflection and penitence

parts.note: sh is the call for silence, so it stands for quiet
the day at the centre of the seven-day week is Wednesday

explanation.surface: A peaceful midweek day gives someone a chance to reflect on their sins.
explanation.definitionFit: The first day of Lent is a Christian day of repentance, marked with ashes.

clue.text: A case of lawyers accepting endless desire for recesses

indicators.note: the outer letters take in the shortened desire word
the outside letters of the word lawyers form its case
the last letter is cut off

parts.note: to covet is to desire

explanation.surface: A legal case in which lawyers take on a boundless wish.
explanation.definitionFit: Alcoves are recesses set into a wall.

clue.text: Removes from board and sulks

definitions.meaning: in draughts, to remove an opponent's piece as a penalty
goes off in a fit of pique

explanation.definitionFit: In draughts a piece can be huffed off the board; a huff is a sulky mood.

clue.text: Create a diversion?

parts.note: a diversion here is amusement, not a distraction or detour

explanation.definitionFit: To amuse or delight people is to provide them with a diversion.

clue.text: Trainspotter getting into designer drugs?

indicators.note: the answer is found inside the words designer drugs

explanation.surface: A railway enthusiast takes up fashionable drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: A trainspotter, in Britain, is a hobbyist who logs train numbers, a byword for geekiness.
explanation.definitionFit: A trainspotter is the British archetype of an obsessive, socially awkward enthusiast.

clue.text: What type of leather has changed colour?

indicators.note: the letters of has are altered in order

parts.note: green is a colour

explanation.surface: Asks what kind of leather has had its colour altered.
explanation.definitionFit: Shagreen is a rough untanned leather, often from sharkskin, frequently dyed green.

clue.text: Adult attraction turning up for prize

parts.note: A is the film-rating abbreviation for adult

indicators.note: in a down clue the word is read upwards, i.e. backwards

parts.note: a draw is something that attracts crowds

explanation.surface: An adult entertainment that appears is rewarded.
explanation.definitionFit: An award is a prize given for achievement.

clue.text: Showing great fear, with time for cold looming

indicators.note: one letter takes the place of another

parts.note: cowering means crouching in great fear
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: Someone frightened, when the weather turns, sees trouble ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with time for cold' puts T in place of C.
explanation.definitionFit: Towering means rising very high, much as something looming does over you.

clue.text: 'Pence' is the French for 'Pound'!

parts.note: est is French for is
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Claims the French word for a pound is pence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pound' looks like the currency, but it is the verb to crush.
explanation.definitionFit: A pestle is the tool used to pound or grind in a mortar.

clue.text: Restaurant's celebration in song after start of Christmas

indicators.note: the start of a word is its opening letter, here of Christmas
the celebration word sits inside the song word

parts.note: an aria is a solo song in opera
a fete is a festive gathering or celebration

explanation.surface: A restaurant holds a carol-singing party to kick off the Christmas season.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after Restaurant stands for 'has' and links the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-service eating place, as in a school or works canteen, is a kind of restaurant.

clue.text: Developed a symbol of England

parts.note: the red rose is England's national flower

explanation.surface: Someone created an emblem for England.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that arose came into being, much as a situation develops.

clue.text: Man of God confined to actual room in church

indicators.note: the holy man is shut inside the word meaning actual

parts.note: very can mean actual or real, as in 'the very thing'
a saint, abbreviated ST, is a holy man

explanation.surface: A clergyman is kept within a real room of the church building.
explanation.definitionFit: The robing room where clergy and choir change and vestments are stored.

clue.text: Concede, about to pass on slope

indicators.note: the word for concede goes around the word for pass on

parts.note: to grant a point is to concede it
to pass on is a euphemism for to die

explanation.surface: Someone agrees, reluctantly, to give up on a hill.
explanation.definitionFit: A gradient is the steepness or incline of a road or hill, i.e. a slope.

clue.text: Run out of gear in a flash

definitions.meaning: to run naked in public, without any clothing
a sudden line of light, as of lightning

explanation.walkthrough: 'in a' just joins the two senses.
explanation.definitionFit: A streaker runs naked; a streak of lightning is a brief flash across the sky.

clue.text: Originally ferried across area to get exclusive

indicators.note: the anagram lies across the area letter, holding it
the letters of ferried are put back into some other original order

explanation.surface: Things first transported across a region become exclusive.
explanation.definitionFit: A rarefied atmosphere is select, refined and exclusive.

clue.text: A banner's principal business?

definitions.note: a banner is a large heading across a front page

parts.note: a head, as of a school, is its principal
one's line is one's trade or business

explanation.surface: Asks what a banner's main purpose is.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is 'has', linking the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A newspaper title in large type across the page is called a banner.

clue.text: Son's up with motorists carrying new mail for religious leader

indicators.note: in a down clue the word for son is read upwards

parts.note: a lad is a son

indicators.note: the motoring organisation holds the rearranged mail inside

parts.note: the AA is the UK Automobile Association

indicators.note: mail made new is rearranged

explanation.surface: A son climbs up with drivers delivering fresh post to a spiritual head.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dalai Lama is the spiritual leader of Tibetan Buddhism.

clue.text: Intellectual's brother tucked into dish served at breakfast

indicators.note: the brother is put inside the dish

parts.note: cereal is a breakfast dish

explanation.surface: An intellectual's brother eats a bowl of cereal at breakfast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tucked into' suggests eating; it puts BR inside. The 's is 'has'.
explanation.definitionFit: Cerebral means of the brain, hence intellectual rather than emotional.

clue.text: Surgeons' initially positive response about call for medical instruments

indicators.note: the first letter of the word Surgeons' is taken
the yes-word goes round the word for call

parts.note: yes is an affirmative answer
to ring someone is to call them on the phone

explanation.surface: Surgeons start by saying yes when asked to make a phone call about their equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: Plungered tubes used for injecting fluids or drawing them out are medical tools.

clue.text: Smart son has something for baby to wear

parts.note: a nappy is the British word for a diaper

explanation.surface: A well-dressed son has a garment for his infant.
explanation.definitionFit: Snappy means stylish, as in a snappy dresser.

clue.text: Easy to follow — a set down!

parts.note: light reading or music is easy to follow

explanation.surface: A remark that something simple to grasp is just an easy put-down.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition sits at the end; 'a' supplies its own letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To get off a vehicle, or a bird landing, is to come down from it or be set down.

clue.text: Hear about old one of Shakespeare's?

indicators.note: the trial word goes round the word for old

parts.note: to hear a case in court is to try it
aged means old

explanation.surface: Asks to hear something about an old Shakespeare play.
explanation.definitionFit: Hamlet, Macbeth and Lear are tragedies, one category of Shakespeare's plays.

clue.text: Moved by a feminine defect after work

indicators.note: the word defect, once worked on, is rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is touched by a woman's flaw after a day at the office.
explanation.definitionFit: To be affected is to be emotionally touched or stirred.

clue.text: Company embracing communist belief system

indicators.note: the company abbreviation wraps around the communist word

parts.note: a red is a communist

explanation.surface: A firm embraces a communist ideology.
explanation.definitionFit: A creed or statement of beliefs, from the Latin for I believe.

clue.text: Bug spies recruiting morally reprehensible person

indicators.note: the spy agency takes the scoundrel inside itself

parts.note: the CIA is the US intelligence agency
a cad is a man who behaves dishonourably

explanation.surface: An intelligence service bugs a room to recruit a scoundrel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bug' reads as a listening device for spies; it is the insect.
explanation.definitionFit: A loud-chirping insect, in the bug order Hemiptera.

clue.text: Criminal, e.g., naturally restricting rise of a good person

indicators.note: in a down clue, the letters run upwards, i.e. backwards
the words hold the letters inside them

explanation.surface: A criminal, naturally, keeps a good person in check.
explanation.definitionFit: Calling someone kind an angel is a common figure of speech.

clue.text: Look at South American prison

parts.note: can is US slang for jail

explanation.surface: Inspect a prison in South America.
explanation.definitionFit: To scan something is to look it over.

clue.text: Newspaper article that is written in politically correct English

indicators.note: the abbreviation for that is placed inside the one for politically correct

parts.note: i.e., id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A newspaper story written in inoffensive English.
explanation.definitionFit: A single written item in a paper is called a piece.

clue.text: Shape approach following ruined broadcast

indicators.note: the approach word comes after the sounded part
something broadcast is heard, so the word for ruined is taken by sound

parts.note: wrecked means ruined
an angle is an approach to a subject

explanation.surface: Someone shapes a new approach after a spoiled transmission.
explanation.definitionFit: A four-sided figure with four right angles is a geometric shape.

clue.text: Wine globally distributed for recreation areas

definitions.note: plural in the clue, while the answer is singular; an alley can hold several lanes

indicators.note: the letters are spread out and rearranged

explanation.surface: Wine is shipped all over the world for leisure centres.
explanation.definitionFit: A building with lanes for tenpin bowling is a place of leisure and recreation.
